title: Technology Sector Update for 10/02/2018: DZSI,MLNX,APH,BABA
text:

Technology stocks fell narrowly this afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing less than 0.1% in value today while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was holding on to a 0.1% advance.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) DASAN Zhone Solutions ( DZSI ) climbed to its best share price since July 2014, rising more than 4% to $15.59 a share, after Tuesday announcing improvements to its broadband product portfolio, including end-to-end 10G-Passive Optical Network computer connections with up to five times more capacity than existing G-PON 100 gigabyte-per-second telecommunication transports.
In other sector news:
(+) Mellanox Technologies ( MLNX ) climbed almost 9% at one point on Tuesday after analysts at Jefferies began coverage of the fabless chipmaker with a Buy stock rating and a $110 price target.
(-) Amphenol ( APH ) has turned lower Tuesday afternoon, drifting off a fractional gain earlier in the session that followed the electronic components company overnight pricing an EUR500 million ($576.8 million) offering of 2.00% senior notes due 2028 at 99.498% of par. Net proceeds will be used to repay existing debt and for general working capital.
(-) Alibaba ( BABA ) was down about 1% this afternoon following reports the Chinese internet company is looking to partner with Indian retailers as it expands its cloud technology and "new retail" concepts to additional markets. According to the Economic Times, Alibaba expects to deploy its augmented reality technology during retail events, such as Single's Day, to improve customer experience.
